tasks.short: Make charts for lectures or court

steps.what: Develop visual aids and charts for lectures
Present those charts as evidence in court

tasks.design: The photographer develops visual aids and charts for use in lectures or to present evidence in court. The charts and the presentation stay at full effort. Nothing in {DOCS} draws the chart or speaks in court.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer makes the chart and presents it.
tasks.still_hard: What the chart shows, and what is said in court, stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not present a chart the assignment does not support.
tasks.altitude: The chart and the court presentation stay at full effort.

reach.task: Say what the lecture or the court must show

evidence.claim: Developing charts for a lecture or for court stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a lecture or a court need and ends when the photographer has presented the chart, or stops.
No new record is required beyond the chart the photographer draws. Upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Which jobs are lectures, and which are court.
research_questions: Which charts did the photographer refuse to present?

already_counted.description: Developing the charts is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the chart adds no separate record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every chart is still made by the photographer. High: the same chart work remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.design: The photographer loads and unloads film. The work stays at full effort. Nothing in {OPS_SYSTEM} loads the camera.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer loads and unloads the film by hand.
tasks.enabler_now: No step replaces the hands-on work.
tasks.still_hard: Loading and unloading stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer stops when the film is not the roll they meant.
tasks.altitude: Loading and unloading stay at full effort.

reach.task: Pass the roll the photographer names
reach.learn: Which rolls were the wrong ones.

evidence.claim: Loading and unloading film stays manual.

assumptions: The work starts with a roll and a camera and ends when the photographer has unloaded it, or stops.
No new record is required. Upkeep is zero.
Sending the film to a laboratory is a different task.
research_questions: How often was the roll the wrong one?

already_counted.description: Loading the film is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the loading adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every roll is still loaded and unloaded by the photographer. High: the same loading remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assemble photograph captions from stored fields
Write the photograph captions in the photographer's words
Review the photograph captions before they are stored

tasks.design: The photographer writes photograph captions. {DOCS} copies only stored who, what, where, and when. A blank field stays blank and stops the draft. The photographer still writes the sentence, at full effort. Only the accepted caption is stored. A model does not write the sentence. Storing the caption does not publish the photograph.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer wrote each caption from notes.
tasks.enabler_now: Stored fields can be copied into a draft line. The sentence stays the photographer's.
tasks.still_hard: The wording stays with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer refuses a caption that fills a blank name.
tasks.altitude: The caption is stored only after the photographer accepts that version. The sentence is not generated.

reach.task: Read only a caption the photographer has accepted

evidence.claim: A captioning proof of concept did not report an accuracy figure, and the publisher said more investment is needed before the wording can be trusted. This step only copies stored fields.
A portrait made without commission may not be published if the person has a reasonable interest against it. Storing a caption is not that publication.

assumptions: The work starts with a photograph and ends when the accepted caption is stored, or the photographer stops. The photograph is not published here.
A caption field set has frame identifier, who, what, where, and when, entered by the photographer from the assignment. A blank field is left blank and is not invented.
The store uses the caption accepted in the review. The draft does not name a person who was not entered.
unknowns: Which photographs must have a caption before they leave the studio.
research_questions: How often did a blank field stop the draft?

already_counted.description: Writing the captions is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: Correct a caption field before the caption is accepted.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: fields are often blank, so the photographer still writes the caption. High: fields are complete, the photographer rewrites and reviews, and only the accepted caption is stored. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Set up an exhibition to display and sell

steps.what: Set up photographic exhibitions for displaying work
Set the exhibition for the purpose of selling work

tasks.design: The photographer sets up photographic exhibitions for the purpose of displaying and selling work. The hanging and the decision to sell stay at full effort. Nothing in {ECOMMERCE} hangs a print or closes a sale. Buyers are not scored.
tasks.previous_blocker: The photographer hangs the exhibition and decides what is for sale.
tasks.still_hard: What is displayed, and what is sold, stay with the photographer.
tasks.human_edge: The photographer does not sell a print they did not choose to show.
tasks.altitude: The exhibition stays at full effort. A sale is not closed by a rule.

reach.task: See the work the photographer chose to hang
reach.learn: Which prints were not for sale.

evidence.claim: Setting up an exhibition and deciding what is for sale stay manual.

assumptions: The work starts with prints and ends when the photographer has hung the exhibition, or stops.
No score is stored. Upkeep is zero. A sale is not closed here.
A licence through an agency is a different task.
unknowns: Which prints are for display only.
research_questions: Which prints did the photographer refuse to sell?

already_counted.description: Setting up the exhibition is already in the photographer's step.

incremental.description: No new upkeep: the exhibition adds no record.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: every exhibition is still set up by the photographer. High: the same exhibition remains, with no step removed. No upkeep is added, so the low does not go below zero. The range stays under the net.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The photographer still shoots, retouches, and chooses the picture. A caption or a licence is written or sent only after the photographer accepts that version.
reach: A client receives only a caption the photographer has accepted.
An agency receives only a licence the photographer has accepted.
skills_to_grow: Stop when a required reading, field, or name is blank.
Accept or refuse the exact version before a write or a send.
Keep the shot, the retouch, and the selection in their own hands.
role.ambitious_version: Every caption traces to stored who, what, where, and when, and the photographer still rewrites the sentence.
